name: Parameters.exists_zeta_pow_eq
summary: It suffices that y^{N₁(P, s)} = 1. Otherwise y^{N₁(P, s)} would be a primitive d(P)-th root of unity in E (the order of y divides N₁(P, s)·d(P), the order of the torsion of ℚ(ζ_{N₁(P, s)·d(P)}) ⊃ E), and φ(d(P))·φ(N₁(P, s)) ≤ [E:ℚ] = 2φ(N₁(P, s)) would give d(P) ≤ 3.

steps.claim: ζ(P, s) is a primitive N₁(P, s)-th root of unity, so y = ζ(P, s)^k for some k < N₁(P, s) once y^{N₁(P, s)} = 1; argue by contradiction, assuming y^{N₁(P, s)} ≠ 1.
steps.lean:
isPrimitiveRoot_zeta.eq_pow_of_pow_eq_one (by_contra (by grind [lt_d, by
  simpa [finrank_eq_two_mul_card_infinitePlace, Fintype.card_congr (placeMulEquiv ..).1, NeZero.pos,
    d_prime, Nat.totient_prime] using totient_mul_totient_le_finrank _ _ (coprime_N₁_d ..)
    isPrimitiveRoot_zeta <| .iff_orderOf.2 <| orderOf_eq_prime (pow_mul y .. ▸
    orderOf_dvd_iff_pow_eq_one.1 ((IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.torsionOrder_eq.trans
      (ite_eq_left (by grind
    [Parameters]))).subst (@NumberField.Units.dvd_torsionOrder_of_isPrimitiveRoot _ _ _ ⟨by simpa⟩ _
    (.map_of_injective (.orderOf y) toCycloField.injective)))) ·]))

steps.claim: From y^{N₁(P, s)} ≠ 1: φ(d(P))·φ(N₁(P, s)) ≤ [E:ℚ] (1.1.1, 1.1.2), while [E:ℚ] = 2·#Φ = 2·φ(N₁(P, s)) (#Φ = #(ℤ/N₁(P, s))^× by placeMulEquiv) and φ(d(P)) = d(P) − 1; so d(P) − 1 ≤ 2, contradicting d(P) > 64.
steps.lean:
isPrimitiveRoot_zeta.eq_pow_of_pow_eq_one (by_contra (by grind [lt_d, by
  simpa [finrank_eq_two_mul_card_infinitePlace, Fintype.card_congr (placeMulEquiv ..).1, NeZero.pos,
    d_prime, Nat.totient_prime] using totient_mul_totient_le_finrank _ _ (coprime_N₁_d ..)
    isPrimitiveRoot_zeta <| .iff_orderOf.2 <| orderOf_eq_prime (pow_mul y .. ▸
    orderOf_dvd_iff_pow_eq_one.1 ((IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.torsionOrder_eq.trans
      (ite_eq_left (by grind
    [Parameters]))).subst (@NumberField.Units.dvd_torsionOrder_of_isPrimitiveRoot _ _ _ ⟨by simpa⟩ _
    (.map_of_injective (.orderOf y) toCycloField.injective)))) ·]))

steps.claim: φ(d(P))·φ(N₁(P, s)) ≤ [E:ℚ], because E contains the primitive N₁(P, s)-th root ζ(P, s) and a primitive d(P)-th root of unity, with N₁(P, s), d(P) coprime.

y^{N₁(P, s)} is a primitive d(P)-th root of unity: (y^{N₁(P, s)})^d(P) = y^{N₁(P, s)·d(P)} = 1 because the order of y divides N₁(P, s)·d(P), the order of the group of roots of unity of ℚ(ζ_{N₁(P, s)·d(P)}) (N₁(P, s)·d(P) even), into which E embeds by toCycloField; and y^{N₁(P, s)} ≠ 1 (the assumption), so its order is the prime d(P).
steps.lean:
<| .iff_orderOf.2 <| orderOf_eq_prime (pow_mul y .. ▸
    orderOf_dvd_iff_pow_eq_one.1 ((IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.torsionOrder_eq.trans
      (ite_eq_left (by grind
    [Parameters]))).subst (@NumberField.Units.dvd_torsionOrder_of_isPrimitiveRoot _ _ _ ⟨by simpa⟩ _
    (.map_of_injective (.orderOf y) toCycloField.injective)))) ·]))
